stories.headline: Saudi Aramco launches Jafurah shale gas project and starts production at Tanajib gas plant
stories.summary: Saudi Aramco began production at the Jafurah unconventional gas field, the Middle East's largest shale play, and commenced operations at the Tanajib Gas Plant. The project aims to increase Saudi gas production capacity by 80% by 2030 and is expected to generate $12-15 billion in operating cash flow.

stories.headline: Drone strike forces shutdown of Saudi Aramco's Ras Tanura refinery
stories.summary: Saudi Aramco halted operations at its 550,000-bpd Ras Tanura refinery after a drone strike caused a limited fire from debris. The facility was shut down as a precaution while assessing damage, though crude exports from nearby terminals remained operational.

articles.title: Drone strike forces shutdown of Aramco's 550,000-bpd Ras Tanura refinery

stories.headline: Saudi PIF injects additional $267 million into LIV Golf, total investment reaches $5.3 billion
stories.summary: Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund approved fresh capital of $266.6 million for LIV Golf in February, bringing total investment since 2021 to $5.3 billion. The golf league's net spending has averaged $100 million per month in 2024-2025, with projections showing PIF investment could exceed $6 billion by year-end.

stories.headline: Saudi Arabia announces $347 million financial support package for Yemen
stories.summary: Saudi Defense Minister Prince Khalid bin Salman announced new financial support worth $347 million to Yemen for government employee salaries and budget relief. The aid reflects ongoing Saudi support to the Yemeni economy during the country's challenging circumstances.

articles.title: Saudi Arabia Provides Yemen with $347 Million to Pay Govt Employee Salaries

stories.headline: Saudi Arabia reports widened budget deficit in Q4 2025
stories.summary: Saudi Arabia's budget deficit increased to 94.85 billion riyals ($25.28 billion) in Q4 2025, up from 88.5 billion riyals in the previous quarter. The widening deficit reflects continued expansionary fiscal policy to support Vision 2030 economic diversification amid oil price volatility.

articles.title: Saudi Arabia deficit widens to $25.28 billion in Q4 2025, finance ministry says
